review: Wei Branch Don Quixote is a Rupture/Sinking Hybrid ID who utilizes her unique debuff, Shattermark, to change the Panic Type of the opponent and/or make them weaker in accordance with whether or not they have SP to lose, making use of the Sinking on Don’s kit. Beginning with Heishou Don’s Passives, we will start with the one that’s always active. - When activating Exalted Command, Lord Hong Lu gets the following effect when his S3 targets Don: Inflict 1 Sinking upon inflicting Rupture Potency or Count by using a Skill up to 3 times per turn. - When Heishou Don is Substituted In or Returned to the Field after retreating, she’ll gain 3 of her unique status: “Burgeoning of Horns.” Next, we will go over Heishou Don’s standard Passive, which activates upon owning 3 Gluttony and 3 Gloom Sin Affinities: - Heishou Don will deal a percentage damage equal to the negative integer of the target’s SP
